comparisonBoundary: Explicit named counterparts only; no unlisted rule is inferred distinct or absent.

rules.when: Visa chapter 8 magnetic-stripe fleet program selected
obligations: Restrict transaction names to the six chapter 8 entries
Resolve CAT, return and reversal mappings before ATL105 serialization
rules.assessment: A supported Petroleum name is not proof of an ATL105 transaction-code mapping or an eligible Visa Fleet 2.0 flow.

rules.when: Deciding whether an account belongs to the chapter 8 fleet program
obligations: Use the explicitly selected draft BIN authority
Retain chapter 8 versus Appendix A BIN disagreement
rules.assessment: Chapter 8 detection is provisional. Neither generic Visa credit nor Visa Fleet 2.0 can be inferred from this BIN decision.

rules.when: Routing a chapter 8 Visa fleet transaction through BUYPASS
obligations: Require the merchant credit option to be enabled
rules.assessment: Merchant configuration is independent of terminal code 091, 080 or 003; the credit option is not a universal fleet enablement flag.

rules.when: Allowing Visa fleet acceptance at a Table-Load or non-Table-Load terminal
obligations: Check the supplied acceptance configuration
Retain ambiguity of card type 020
Require an explicit alternate method when Table Load is not used
rules.assessment: The generic Prompt Code context rule does not settle ambiguous Table Load card-type extraction or provision the alternate method.

rules.when: Encoding a supported Visa fleet financial transaction
obligations: Combine the selected transaction code and card type
Do not turn provisional 020 or CAT mappings into an approved wire value
rules.assessment: Specializes Prompt Code composition, but the complete value depends on two unresolved mappings. Generic format correctness cannot approve the fleet mapping.

rules.when: The Visa fleet Service Prompt requires Driver ID
obligations: Capture one to six numeric digits
Keep this Driver ID unencrypted
rules.assessment: The fleet six-digit cap is narrower than the general Element 31 capacity. Driver ID is not a PIN; Interlink DUKPT policy must not be inherited.

rules.when: The Visa fleet Service Prompt or manual entry requires odometer
obligations: Capture one to eight numeric digits
rules.assessment: Shares numeric eight-character representation with the segment rule, but adds a fleet-specific collection trigger; optional field representation alone does not establish that trigger.

rules.when: The Visa fleet Service Prompt requests Vehicle Number
obligations: Capture one to six numeric digits
Do not require an authorization signature solely for the Vehicle Number prompt
rules.assessment: Narrows the generic ten-character AN field. Signature behavior is a separate device obligation, not established by field validation or a logical positive case.

rules.when: The Visa fleet Service Prompt or keyed profile requires ID
obligations: Apply the explicitly selected draft ID-length interpretation
Keep exact-six versus maximum-six conflict visible
rules.assessment: Driver ID, ID Number and Vehicle Number remain separate prompt concepts. Accepting shorter ID values is a conflicting draft oracle, not a confirmed source resolution.

rules.when: A Visa fleet card is swiped and its Service Prompt is available
obligations: Read the fleet prompt position
Select exactly the requested data prompts
rules.assessment: Swiped prompt selection is distinct from the fixed keyed profile and does not prove message placement for the prompt values.

rules.when: Visa fleet stripe reads fail and manual fallback is used
obligations: Require the selected three-attempt draft boundary
Capture the sixteen-digit account
rules.assessment: The legacy entry-method representation rule does not specify three attempts or a fleet PAN length. Source retry wording remains an explicit interpretation.

rules.when: Visa fleet account entry is manual
obligations: Mark the account with a leading asterisk on the receipt
Apply the same manual-entry mark in the journal
rules.assessment: Receipt and journal output are separate observation surfaces; account-field serialization does not establish either output.

rules.when: A chapter 8 Visa fleet transaction is processed
obligations: Perform device expiration validation
rules.assessment: The outcome parallels credit expiration validation, but fleet applicability is independently sourced. Transmitting an expired value is a different obligation and does not waive validation.

rules.when: Printing a Visa fleet cardholder receipt
obligations: Suppress the expiration date on the cardholder receipt
rules.assessment: Suppressing a printed value does not prohibit sending required expiration data to the host. A transmission test cannot substitute for receipt inspection.

rules.when: A draft Visa fleet Authorization Only transaction is sent
obligations: Supply expiration even if expired
Retain the unresolved breadth of the term authorization
rules.assessment: The legacy manual MMYY encoding and device expiry validation are separate from authorization transmission. Purchase eligibility is not inferred from codes 3 and 5.

rules.when: Checking a full chapter 8 Visa fleet account number
obligations: Evaluate Mod 10 over the full fleet account
Keep failure handling separate from the check itself
rules.assessment: Payment-token LUHN/BIN rules are not equivalent to this physical fleet account requirement; a token rule must not supply fleet applicability.

rules.when: An original Visa fleet transaction uses ordinary stripe processing
obligations: Prefer readable Track 2
Use unaltered readable Track 1 before manual fallback
rules.assessment: Track preference and fallback share behavior with non-Amex credit but keep a separate fleet scope, account formation and retry policy.

rules.when: A Visa fleet follow-on in the ordinary non-TransArmor-VeriFone profile is sent
obligations: Use account plus equals separator plus YYMM expiry
Do not add full track discretionary content
rules.assessment: Partial follow-on data differs from splitting an original track. Follow-on versus previously-authorized applicability and the excluded TransArmor profile remain explicit.

rules.when: Transmitting Visa fleet Track 1 fallback data
obligations: Omit the Track 1 start sentinel from transmitted data
rules.assessment: Removing a card-image sentinel is not the same assertion as separating account and discretionary fields; both are needed in their own layers.

rules.when: Parsing a Visa fleet physical track image
obligations: Check PAN and separator layout
Read expiry and service-code positions
Require fleet fixed position zero
rules.assessment: Physical image grammar is not ATL105 online encoding. Source sentinel/LRC exclusions must survive any serializer; a card-image logical PASS is not a wire PASS.

rules.when: Visa fleet Service Enhancement Indicator equals 2
obligations: Allow only the selected Petroleum fuel category codes
rules.assessment: A code can exist in the generic product table and still be prohibited by this fleet restriction. Reserved enhancement values need a separate decision.

rules.when: Visa fleet Service Enhancement Indicator equals 1
obligations: Allow fuel and the explicitly drafted maintenance categories
Retain the unresolved definition of maintenance
rules.assessment: The drafted 100-149 maintenance range is not approved by generic product-code validity. Do not silently generalize it to other fleet programs.

rules.when: Building the product list for a Visa fleet transaction
obligations: Apply the draft uniqueness rule
Keep fuel-only versus all-product scope unresolved
rules.assessment: The legacy rule requires uniqueness per fuel type. The current draft extends uniqueness to every product code; this is a scope extension, not full equivalence.

rules.when: Visa fleet products have no discounts, coupons or separately modeled taxes
obligations: Supply a nonempty product list
Reconcile the product amount sum with the transaction total
rules.assessment: Code validity does not prove amount conservation. Netting, taxes, rounding and Table 078 replacement/supplement rules remain unresolved outside the stated draft subset.

rules.when: Encoding products for the chapter 8 Visa fleet profile
obligations: Use the Petroleum Appendix B code set
rules.assessment: Petroleum Appendix B and ATL105 Appendix F are not identical authorities: ATL105-only 541-549 must not be silently admitted by this rule.

rules.when: The Visa fleet account is keyed
obligations: Prompt for ID and odometer
Do not prompt for Driver ID or Vehicle Number
Use the keyed-profile product permission
rules.assessment: This keyed profile is an explicit exception to stripe Service Prompt restrictions. It is not a generic manual-entry policy for Visa credit or other fleet programs.

rules.when: Voyager Fleet chapter 9 program selected
obligations: Use the six named chapter 9 transactions
Retain provisional CAT, return and reversal message mapping
rules.assessment: The Petroleum transaction-name list does not independently approve ATL105 codes or a generic Voyager payment flow.

rules.when: Voyager Fleet financial processing is selected
obligations: Use fleet card type 060 within the selected transaction Prompt Code
rules.assessment: The card-type component specializes generic context encoding. Complete Prompt Code mapping and deployed acceptance configuration remain separately evidenced.

rules.when: Enabling Voyager Fleet at the merchant
obligations: Enable Terminal Special Code 073
rules.assessment: 073 must not be replaced by Fleet One 091, FleetCor 080 or COMDATA 003. A shared terminal-special field is not shared program enablement.

rules.when: Deciding whether the terminal accepts Voyager Fleet
obligations: Read Voyager fleet acceptance from Table Load
Use an explicit alternate acceptance method if Table Load is absent
rules.assessment: An alternate-method Boolean in synthetic data is not a supplied routing or merchant contract.

rules.when: Voyager magstripe restriction requires Driver ID
obligations: Capture one to six numeric digits
Keep the Driver ID unencrypted
rules.assessment: Driver ID is not an encrypted PIN and does not inherit Interlink PIN-block rules. EMV prompting follows a different trigger.

rules.when: Voyager magstripe restrictions request odometer
obligations: Capture one to eight numeric digits
rules.assessment: Eight-digit representation is shared; the Voyager restriction trigger is additional and cannot be inferred merely from a populated field.

rules.when: Three Voyager stripe reads fail and manual entry is selected
obligations: Capture the draft account length
Capture ISO, expiry and restriction data in the selected order
Retain account/ISO boundary ambiguity
rules.assessment: Entry-method compatibility does not settle whether the nineteen digits include ISO or the exact host field boundaries; no complete serializer is authorized by the draft.

rules.when: Reading Voyager magstripe restriction first digit
obligations: Accept the stated 0-3 prompt restriction set
Select the corresponding Driver ID and odometer prompts
rules.assessment: The magstripe first-digit trigger is not the chip Tag 9F6E prompt trigger and must not be reused as an EMV oracle.

rules.when: Voyager fuel restriction is available in its applicable entry profile
obligations: Differentiate fuel-only and fuel-plus-other-product permissions
Enforce the selected fuel-only category restriction
rules.assessment: Catalog membership and card permission are distinct. Magstripe and chip restriction representations must not be conflated.

rules.when: Building a Voyager Fleet product-bearing transaction
obligations: Supply Product Code Data
Reconcile product amounts to transaction amount
rules.assessment: Generic code validity does not establish product presence or total conservation. A synthetic equality observation is not a host-approved accounting result.

rules.when: Sending an original electronic Voyager Fleet transaction
obligations: Use Track 2 as the default
rules.assessment: Only the default preference is common. Do not import generic-credit Track 1 fallback, Visa fleet service positions or manual PAN length.

rules.when: Sending a Voyager follow-on with its TransArmor-VeriFone status supplied
obligations: Use partial Track 2 in the ordinary profile
Retain full Track 2 for the specifically stated exception
rules.assessment: Generic split rules do not determine follow-on eligibility or the encryption-profile exception. Ordinary partial and exception full-track paths are mutually scoped.

rules.when: Processing a Voyager Fleet transaction
obligations: Perform device expiration validation
rules.assessment: Same device-check outcome as credit, but independently applies to Voyager Fleet. EBT, stored-value, loyalty and Money Code expiry exemptions do not transfer.

rules.when: Keying Voyager Fleet account information
obligations: Prompt separately for ISO
Prefix ISO to the selected account representation
rules.assessment: The ISO-prefix obligation is separate from the unresolved nineteen-digit boundary. Account-entry compatibility does not resolve formation.

rules.when: Voyager Fleet account is manually entered
obligations: Mark manual entry with an asterisk on receipt
Apply the mark in the journal
rules.assessment: Shares a behavior with Visa fleet but has its own program source. Neither receipt nor journal completion is proved by account payload presence.

rules.when: Collecting Voyager magstripe transaction prompts
obligations: Do not solicit Vehicle Number
rules.assessment: A general optional vehicle field does not require prompting. The magstripe prohibition must not be broadened to all Voyager EMV issuer prompt scripts.

rules.when: Receiving a Voyager Authorization Only result in its applicable POS flow
obligations: Bound the approved maximum by the request
Retain the request-based POS authorization interpretation
rules.assessment: This is not a credit partial-reversal amount rule. Approval bounds and the later reversal amount are distinct events.

rules.when: Voyager CAT Authorization Only returns an approved maximum
obligations: Apply the lower of approved maximum and AFP pump limit
rules.assessment: The pump-cap outcome parallels WEX OTR but Voyager explicitly includes the AFP limit. No generic cross-program pump oracle is approved.

rules.when: Listing fuel purchases in a Voyager Fleet transaction
obligations: Use a unique Product Code for each fuel type
rules.assessment: Shares the fuel-type uniqueness core, not the broader Visa draft all-product uniqueness. ATL105 source release/applicability remains separate.

rules.when: Checking Voyager account data in a selected POS/manual profile
obligations: Check the account check-digit span
Keep manual first-eight-digit behavior separate
Retain the unresolved Mod 10 variant
rules.assessment: The common Luhn implementation in fixtures is provisional. It does not settle issuer algorithm or manual field boundaries.

rules.when: Checking Voyager super-check-digit data in a selected entry profile
obligations: Include ISO/account/card-identifier data in the selected span
Include ISO for manual processing
Retain algorithm and span uncertainty
rules.assessment: The super check is a different obligation from the account check. Passing one Luhn observation cannot prove both source-defined checks.

rules.when: Interpreting Voyager chip Third Party Data
obligations: Check the selected Third Party Data unique identifier
Check the enhanced-fleet Product Identifier
rules.assessment: Chip application qualification is distinct from choosing Segment 145. A generic enhanced-fleet segment cannot establish the issuer's chip qualification.

rules.when: Selecting a Voyager chip application on a multi-application terminal
obligations: Match the Voyager AID
Apply priority one under the selected application policy
rules.assessment: The AID suffix does not make this a Mastercard payment program. Application matching and configured priority remain separate from host routing.

rules.when: The Voyager chip card is removed before the terminal requests card removal
obligations: Abort the current transaction
Send a reversal if an authorization response has already been received
Keep pre-first-GENERATE-AC power-off handling stage-specific
rules.assessment: The source means the terminal's card-removal request, not the outgoing authorization request. An early removal can therefore require a post-authorization reversal; do not erase that branch.

rules.when: Evaluating Voyager chip products with applicable online/offline limits
obligations: Check chip purchase restrictions
Apply relevant fuel and nonfuel limits before acceptance
rules.assessment: Voyager chip restrictions, WEX OTR unlisted-product prohibition and a host fuel-limit response table are three separate inputs; no inheritance or full equivalence.

rules.when: Printing an approved Voyager chip receipt
obligations: Print the selected AID
Print the preferred name or application label
rules.assessment: Application-selection data must reach the receipt surface. A logical EMV facts object is not receipt execution evidence.

rules.when: Reading the applicable Voyager physical-track service-code position
obligations: Inspect the correct Track 1 or Track 2 service-code location
Prompt insertion for the specified chip-capability indicators
rules.assessment: Physical-track position detection is not the ATL105 entry-mode field. Do not use transmitted partial-track positions or generic fallback to decide chip capability.

rules.when: Voyager chip prompting has no Prompt Script File
obligations: Present enabled prompt bits in order 4,3,2,1
rules.assessment: The no-script terminal prompt order is distinct from encoding an authorizer-specific Prompt Table. It must not override a supplied script.

rules.when: Investigating abnormal Voyager chip declines
obligations: Retain the recommended chip and terminal-decision troubleshooting evidence
rules.assessment: Evidence retention is operational behavior, not an authorization decision. Storage policy and retention duration are not supplied by a synthetic Boolean.

rules.when: Configuring a Voyager chip terminal
obligations: Use online-only or offline-capable-with-online terminal behavior
rules.assessment: Offline capability does not mean offline-only operation and does not inherit COMDATA SAF prohibition or WEX recovery rules.

rules.when: Configuring the Voyager chip application
obligations: Supply the required application-wide terminal parameters
Obtain and verify the referenced TAC appendix values
rules.assessment: Appendices J/K/L and the approved terminal baseline are not independently validated by the bounded companion. A supports-required-parameters flag cannot close those values.

rules.when: Selecting CVM for a Voyager chip transaction with attendance known
obligations: Support No CVM
Support online enciphered PIN
Prohibit offline PIN
Allow signature only at attended terminals
rules.assessment: CVM support and attendance policy are not Interlink DUKPT implementation. No crypto-authenticity or approved terminal-kernel evidence follows from logical flags.

rules.when: Voyager chip terminal is offline-capable
obligations: Support DDA
Support CDA
Treat SDA as optional
rules.assessment: Capabilities are conditional on offline support. SDA must not be promoted from optional to required or used to replace DDA/CDA.

rules.when: Voyager chip Third Party Data is available
obligations: Derive applicable prompt requirements from Tag 9F6E
rules.assessment: Chip tag interpretation precedes host Prompt Table serialization. Neither layer is a substitute for the other; issuer-specific and script conditions stay attached.

rules.when: Interpreting the Voyager account portion after ISO
obligations: Check the listed 85-89 account prefix set
rules.assessment: This is a Voyager account-prefix constraint, not a Visa BIN test, payment-token BIN flag or general Element 2 representation rule.
